name: Parker Agrochem Exports Ltd.
about: Parker Agrochem Exports Ltd., a liquid storage company, engages in the rental of storage tank farms in India. The company develops petroleum and edible oil storage tanks that connect pipelines with Port/ Jetty for directly loading and unloading ships. It also trades commodities, such as gold and silver. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
